text:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need to pair SI trainers with partner teams for the next onboarding cohort. goal is shadowing + proctored certs, not just slide decks.

devon: Timeline idea: 2 weeks shadow, 1 week hands-on labs, day for cert. Thoughts?

sam: Works. Recommend pairing 1 trainer -> 2 partner engineers max. keeps quality high.

anya: Lab access is the blocker — onprem partners need hardware ACLs. raised infra ticket earlier.

ops-bot: INF-TICKET-412 created for lab creds provisioning (owner: eng-infra). ETA 48h.

maria: Good. Also need a single playbook page per partner with: scope, success metrics, training owner, sign-off checklist. I'll draft template.

devon: Can we include a short troubleshooting cheat sheet? common gotchas for SI installs: network ports, GPU driver mismatches, KMS keys.

sam: I'll add a 1-page proctor guide for the certification run (timings, allowed resources, grading rubric).

anya: For hardware partners, we should include a compatibility matrix. I'll ping HW partner team for their latest firmware matrix.

maria: Marketing — hold on any joint announcement until 2nd cohort passes certs. We want a partner success quote. @marketing?

marketing: Ack. We'll aim to draft announcement copy but hold publishing until we get case study approval.

maria: Proposed kickoff meeting: Wed 10am PT. Agenda: introductions, trainer->partner match, lab access status, cert schedule, comm plan.

devon: Calendar invite sent. Includes Confluence doc link and the playbook template.

sam: Note for trainers: bring one short demo (10m) and one failover plan for demos. put in the playbook under "demo runbook".

anya: For proctoring pairs, I can co-run the first two sessions to train new proctors.

maria: Perfect. I'll share the initial partner list here before the meeting: [acme-systems, delta-integrations, northbridge-sis].

devon: I'll draft the partner-specific learning paths and share by EOD.

maria: small config snippet for lab prep (share with partners):
```
# basic lab ssh example
ssh -i si_lab_key.pem ubuntu@10.42.1.10
sudo ./setup_lab.sh --gpu-driver auto --k8s-namespace si-onboard
```

sam: Reminder: include a rollback/demo fallback (hosted demo) so partner demos don't depend on local HW during client meetings.

maria: noted. thanks everyone — see you Wed. :thumbsup:
